column1: # EXP-R2-229: the logit lens in BOTH modes of one Galactica checkpoint, four rungs
# of one training run. Four cells, one per rung, and each cell loads its checkpoint
# ONCE and measures four modes over those weights -- text, the declared protein
# rendering, the same forward pass under a position-capped mask, and the naive
# rendering. There is no per-mode cell because there is no per-mode load.
# Every draw is the value the freeze binds this campaign to, and every one of them
# is 21_joint_mode_qualification.py's own default, because the point of this
# measurement is that the lens is read on the IDENTICAL 128 records that stage
# qualified each rung on: cohort draw seed 20260728, 128 records, residue band
# 64-246, text floor 800 characters. Those are the stage's defaults and are not
# restated on the command line -- a default spelled again in a manifest is a second
# declaration that stops tracking the first. The two content digests are checked
# against the stage-41 reports inside every artefact.
# --checkpoint is a path and not an arm name on purpose, and no ArmSpec for these
# rungs exists anywhere in arms.py: 21_joint_mode_qualification.py's rule is that a
# joint checkpoint which has not passed it must not be in arms.py at all, and
# e500d14 reverted an earlier STAGED_ARMS declaration on exactly that ground.
# ${TRANSFER_MODEL_BASE_DIR} is substituted by the runner from h200_env.sh, so no
# site path is written here.
# NO --identification IS PASSED HERE. The verdict is a CPU function of this
# artefact and the rung's own 41_context_information_bootstrap.py report, and those
# reports live in the analysis tree on the workstation rather than on GPFS. Every
# cell therefore writes its gate as `refused` with that reason, and `--stage gate`
# takes the verdict after the records are pulled. The split is stage 21's own
# argument for its sufficient-statistics sidecar.
# Slot 1 is the three rungs that fit comfortably beside each other on three cards.
# galactica-30b has slot 2 to itself: 48 layers of width 7168 is about 57 GB of
# weights at bfloat16 against 143771 MiB of card, and stage 21 measured its peak at
# 60,025 MiB there, so it is a single-card cell and is given a card with nothing
# else settling on it. An out-of-memory failure is reported as measured and is NOT
# retried at a smaller draw: the draw is what makes the rung comparable to the
# three below it.
# galactica-125m is the INSTRUMENT rung. Its protein mode reads -0.131060 nats per
# residue on the qualification cohort and is not identified, so no capability
# verdict may be taken from it; it is here for the fourth text rung and because its
# trajectories are the attainability and precision-invariance evidence the freeze
# rests on.
